children: The finance executive brings around 29 years of experience across corporate finance, capital raising, trade finance and forex

Mitish Somani has been appointed Chief Financial Officer at Sunstream Green Energy, bringing around 29 years of experience across corporate finance, capital raising, trade finance and foreign exchange. A Chartered Accountant, Somani has held senior finance positions across renewable energy, infrastructure, manufacturing and steel.
Somani joined Sunstream Green Energy in May 2026 and will oversee the company’s finance function. His appointment comes as the company works towards building a 1 GW renewable energy platform.

His professional experience includes corporate finance, financial structuring, capital raising, trade finance and forex. Over his career, he has been involved in raising and structuring more than Rs 18,000 cr in capital for energy and infrastructure projects.
Before joining Sunstream Green Energy, Somani was Director, Finance at Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners from August 2024 to June 2025. He managed finance for the investment firm’s India operations.

Somani spent nearly nine years with Avaada Group, where he served as Senior Executive Vice President – Corporate Finance from March 2013 to January 2022. His role involved leading the corporate finance function.
His experience in renewable energy and infrastructure has included work on funding requirements, financial structuring and capital management for large-scale projects.
Prior to Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners, Somani served as Head of Finance at Evonith Steel from April 2024 to July 2024.
He was also CFO at First Energy, a Thermax group company, from February 2022 to April 2024. The role added experience in finance management within the energy and industrial sectors.
Across his career, Somani has worked across corporate finance, trade finance and foreign exchange, with experience spanning different business and capital structures.

Somani’s finance background comes as Sunstream Green Energy scales its renewable energy platform. The CFO role is expected to cover financial oversight and corporate finance as the company develops its project and capital requirements.
Somani is a Chartered Accountant and holds a B.Com from NM College. He completed his Chartered Accountancy qualification in 1995.

His career has included finance leadership roles across renewable energy, infrastructure, steel and industrial businesses, providing experience in managing financial functions within capital-intensive sectors.
Conclusion: Somani brings nearly three decades of finance experience to Sunstream Green Energy, including senior roles in renewable energy and corporate finance.
